plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Brain Navigator reads your sleep, resting heart rate and steps to fill in your daily check-in. It stays on your phone.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Brain Navigator saves mindful minutes to Health when you log them.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Brain Navigator uses your approximate location for the weather and today's sunset, which set the room's sky.

plugins.microphonePermission: Brain Navigator uses the microphone when you choose to: to speak an entry instead of typing it, and for the optional room-noise check on the Sleep card. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.

plugins.photosPermission: Brain Navigator opens your photos only when you pick one: a screenshot of your schedule or grades to read on the phone, or a picture for an entry.

plugins.microphonePermission: Brain Navigator uses the microphone when you choose to: to speak an entry instead of typing it, and for the optional room-noise check on the Sleep card. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Brain Navigator turns what you say into text on your phone, so you can speak an entry.
